notes_for_editor: Thin evidence: the story is about 100 words by design. 'Apex Mountain' is also the name of the ski resort (Apex Mountain Resort, on Beaconsfield Mountain per Wikipedia), and I did not verify that the lookout sits on the same summit as the registry coordinates (49.36, -119.911). Facebook pages were readable only as titles (login wall). A search snippet mentions a former name 'Snow' and the lookout being idled in 1932-33 and reactivated in 1934; I did not fetch that page, so none of it is in the story. Worth checking BC Forest Service records. The brief record had no staffing, height or build data.
